info_only_not_selectable.X_cb: best robust pool + 0.05 * z(best existing CatBoost val model), to answer whether a CatBoost solver adds anything to the pool (fixed weight, no fitting); never eligible as a pick

spec: per-feed rank-z of each member; branch = mean over members (weighted for C4); final = 0.5*z(FT branch) + 0.5*z(TO branch); holdout = z-mean of train-only members (same weights)

proxies_vs_C0.V: val NDCG delta of the final pool, paired per feed, user-cluster SE (user_id 0 = singletons)
proxies_vs_C0.Vp: val delta weighted by nn_x/pubdiag/shift/p2_adv_weights.npz['private_intrinsic+hour'] (chosen a priori by the shift agent; SE via n_eff)
proxies_vs_C0.Vto: val delta of the train-only branch alone
proxies_vs_C0.H: holdout delta (train-only pools), paired per feed
proxies_vs_C0.D: Vto - H, the val excess the in-period holdout does not confirm (SE = hypot)
proxies_vs_C0.E0: Vp            (lambda=0: val gains transfer to private 1:1)
proxies_vs_C0.E1: Vp - D        (lambda=1: only the holdout-confirmed part transfers)
proxies_vs_C0.S: min(E0, E1) = worst case over lambda in [0,1]  (robust score)

eligibility_vs_C0: e3: no val slice (M<50, M>=50, Tue, Thu, coldpos, warmpos) below -2 SE and no holdout slice (weekday, weekend) below -2 SE
e5: src/pmix private-mix delta >= -1 SE (project veto rule, CURRENT_STATUS 12:42)
e6: src/presub_gate.py PASS (run on the top 1-3 by S)

selection.safest_pick: eligible argmax S. If the top two S differ by < 0.00010, prefer the lower re-cooled weight share, then more families.
selection.hedge: if the pick is not the eligible argmax of E0, the hedge is the eligible argmax of E0 (covers 'val transfers 1:1'); otherwise the eligible argmax of E1 (covers 'only holdout-confirmed gains transfer')
selection.replace_current_pick1: the safest pick replaces PF7x (C0) only if its S > 0 AND it is eligible; otherwise PF7x stays
